decisions.title: DR-CPC-001 applied to the printed set
decisions.detail: CPC header = uppercase eyebrow + location headline + hollow violation pill; firm-name identity; ink rating stars. Applied during pass 2 after finding the ratified record in the CPC ledger.

decisions.title: Numeric binding policy
decisions.detail: Never hard-code numerics; snap to nearest DS token, ties round down. Ticket paper radii exempt as protected custom design.

decisions.title: DS Button adopted directly
decisions.detail: All button usages instance the Guidelines Button set (key 624f386331f5011ab67eba8f318994a7fbff4369). OTR/Cases/ActionButton archived. Kind map: blue/primary to Solid-brand, money to Solid-error, ghost to Outline-neutral, grad to Gradient-brand. SmartMatch gradient and ink primary have no DS types; asks live on the Diffs section.

decisions.title: Component-reuse policy
decisions.detail: Audit the DS library component inventory before printing any component; instance or wrap DS components where they map honestly; print divergences as diffs.

decisions.title: Native type collection (Proposal C, amended)
decisions.detail: 13 styles, built and bound. Title placed (Page EB25, Hero EB20, Section B16, Subsection EB14); Text sized then emphasized (Large/Regular/Small/Caption folders, Standard/Action/Highlight leaves); Caption styles uppercase via textCase; integer ladder only; facts keys fold into Caption/Note; Ticket mono protected as Native/Ticket. OTR/Cases working styles deleted after rebind (187 nodes).

decisions.title: Proposals A and B
decisions.detail: Superseded by C. Panels stay on the Proposed section as the decision record.

decisions.title: Metanoia reference deployment
decisions.detail: sample-metanoia/ deleted per root CLAUDE.md provision, first OTR deployment being complete.

decisions.title: July 7 CPC pairing board ratified as card canon
decisions.detail: CasePreviewCard gains form axis (card|compact) and signal mods per component-case_preview_cards board. In-card CTA buttons retired from lifecycle cards in favor of tinted whole-block taps; court/outcome metalines removed; meter confined to mod=unfinished. Legacy matching-family variants untouched pending CD coverage.

decisions.title: CD escalation gap acknowledged
decisions.detail: Exploration decisions in CD were not escalated to root HTMLs, so canon-stage boards can trail ratified design. Until CD restructures: before printing any board, cross-check its recency against exploration decisions and confirm with the user. Simplified CD project proposal drafted in docs/prds/prd-cd-workflow-v2.md.

decisions.title: CPC family split + SignalBlock system
decisions.detail: Per the system board (badge rule + action signals): CasePreviewCard split into six family component sets so each property panel shows only valid signals; signal UI extracted to OTR/Cases/SignalBlock (tone x density, six fixed tones incl. inactive gray) instanced by all cards and compact rows; icons promoted to OTR/Icons components for swap overrides. Superseded variants (deadline, missed, counter, active-action, reassigned, tap) deprecated to Archive. OPEN: quote-family CTA treatment; StatusBadge vocabulary shrink to 5+2.
decisions.decidedBy: user delegated the model choice; agent applied CD's system board

decisions.title: No buttons on cards, anywhere
decisions.detail: Ratified via video brief (Loom transcript, Jul 29): blue DS Buttons must not appear in any case preview card. SmartMatch quote/quote-urgent/expired and Incomplete draft converted to signal blocks (match, warning, inactive, warning). Closes the quote-family CTA question from D-010. Legitimate buttons remain on empty-state screens, HelpZone, and Detail/ActionItem (signal-owns-its-button per system board, detail surface only).
